chapter.title: Stormy Night
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 at flowchart-node level from the PowerPyx 100% chart (73 boxes, 63 distinct labels, nine endings) and the game’s own text (detroitbecometext template: five prompts, fourteen options, no clue and no stat arrow). Dinner’s Ready → Wait on Todd & Alice → Todd Gets Mad → BREAK PROGRAMMING or not → GO UPSTAIRS / REASON WITH TODD / blocking him / too slow → before Todd (RUN WITH ALICE and the hide, LOCK ROOM with the lamp, talk or window, SPEAK TO TODD, [ OUT OF TIME ] and REFUSE / ACCEPT) or after Todd (TAKE GUN, THREATEN WITH GUN or DEFEND ALICE) → Kara or Alice shoots Todd, or Kara stuns him and runs: front door, backyard, fight downstairs, yard, bus. Nine endings: four survivals (Kara Shot Todd, Alice Shot Todd, Kara & Alice Fought Their Way Out, Kara & Alice Evaded Todd) and five deaths (Todd Kills Alice, Todd Broke Kara in the Corridor, Downstairs, and Outside twice). Experienced mode is modelled, so every chart node is reachable. No probability, opinion, instability or Alice change. Cross-chapter: the gun and the window from A New Home in; Todd’s fate, the gun, Kara’s death, whether Todd was hurt and whether he chased Kara out. Researched in docs/research/ch07-stormy-night.md.

decisions.title: Dinner’s Ready (checkpoint), Wait on Todd & Alice, Todd Gets Mad (checkpoint)
decisions.context: Kara serves dinner; Todd, high on Red Ice, rants about androids, turns on Alice, throws the table aside and hits her. Alice runs upstairs; Todd orders Kara: “You stay there! Don’t you dare fucking move.”

options.label: Scripted, no choice
options.effect: Free roam with dialogue variants only (serve late, light off, moving during the rant).

decisions.note: Two checkpoints and an unmissable arrow; no icon.

benchmark.note: Narrated in K02’s situation. The free-roam variants have no prompt in the template and are not offered; the shared test “a dead protagonist never receives future decisions” also allows no chapter-7 scene before K02.

decisions.title: Obey Todd or break programming?
decisions.context: Todd orders Kara not to move and goes after Alice with his belt. The order is a wall Kara must push through.

options.label: BREAK PROGRAMMING → KARA BECOMES DEVIANT
options.effect: Kara can move and protect Alice.

options.label: KARA FAILS TO BECOME DEVIANT → TODD KILLS ALICE
options.effect: Ending (not required). Todd kills Alice, blames Kara and destroys her.

decisions.gate: Reach this scene with the character alive.
decisions.note: No failure branch on breaking through: it is a held input.

benchmark.note: Two options, no risk, no stat change; obeying ends Kara’s story (kara and alice false). Story 1.9.7: Todd’s android rant is complete (“Course, androids are so fucking wonderful…”; MiKeYROG 100% walkthrough, g_DQfghTbLg 52:59).

decisions.title: Do something now: go upstairs, reason, block Todd, or stay out?
decisions.context: Kara has broken her programming. Todd is in the living room, about to go up after Alice.

options.label: GO UPSTAIRS
options.effect: Reach the landing before Todd.

options.label: REASON WITH TODD
options.effect: The three-button prompt; Todd shoves Kara down and goes up.

options.label: KARA IS IN TODD’S WAY DOWNSTAIRS
options.effect: Todd shoves Kara downstairs and goes up: Get to Alice after Todd.

options.label: KARA IS TOO SLOW → TODD KILLS ALICE
options.effect: Ending (not required).

decisions.note: The wiki: blocking in the living room, stairway or hallway plays a different shove; deviating late removes REASON WITH TODD.

benchmark.note: One menu of the four ways on; blocking is on the stairs, and REASON WITH TODD is always offered.

decisions.title: Reason with Todd (downstairs)
decisions.context: The template’s prompt: CALM (“Todd, it’s not right for a father to hurt his daughter.”), DETERMINED (“You should leave her alone, Todd, she-”), UNDERSTANDING (“Todd, please, I know you’re angry, but-”).

options.label: CALM / DETERMINED / UNDERSTANDING
options.effect: No stat change; Todd shoves Kara downstairs and goes up.

benchmark.note: Three options with the game’s labels and lines.

decisions.title: Upstairs before Todd: Alice’s room, the gun, or the hallway
decisions.context: Kara is on the landing ahead of Todd.

options.label: Go into Alice’s room
options.effect: Get to Alice before Todd.

options.label: TAKE GUN (gun seen in A New Home)
options.effect: Todd comes up and goes to Alice: Get to Alice after Todd, armed.

options.label: KARA IS IN TODD’S WAY UPSTAIRS
options.effect: Todd shoves Kara upstairs: Get to Alice after Todd.

decisions.note: TAKE GUN is locked without the A New Home unlock.

benchmark.note: TAKE GUN requires gunDiscovered and sets gun.

decisions.title: Take Todd’s gun?
decisions.context: Todd has reached Alice first. The gun Kara saw in A New Home is in his nightstand.

options.label: TAKE GUN
options.effect: Go in armed: THREATEN WITH GUN, and Todd ends up shot.

options.label: Go straight in
options.effect: Unarmed: DEFEND ALICE → STUN TODD; Todd can survive and reappear at the terminal.

decisions.gate: Gun seen in A New Home; offered on the way to Get to Alice after Todd (after either shove or a failed hide) and upstairs before Todd.
decisions.note: Cross-chapter: the gun leaves the house only through KARA SHOT TODD or ALICE SHOT TODD.

benchmark.note: Taking it sets gun. The old fight-in-one-scene with unsourced 10%/30% risks and an Alice decrease is gone.

decisions.title: Get to Alice before Todd: run, lock, speak, or out of time
decisions.context: Alice: “He’s coming! He’s gonna hurt me! Run! Get away or he’s gonna break you like last time.” Ten seconds (PowerPyx).

options.label: RUN WITH ALICE (chart: RUN AWAY)
options.effect: Try to hide in the corridor.

options.label: LOCK ROOM (chart: LOCK DOOR)
options.effect: Lamp, talk, or the window.

options.label: SPEAK TO TODD (chart: REASON WITH TODD)
options.effect: Todd shoves Kara upstairs: Get to Alice after Todd.

options.label: [ OUT OF TIME ]
options.effect: Todd is coming → Out of time → Todd breaks into bedroom.

decisions.gate: After going into Alice’s room ahead of Todd.
decisions.note: Focus point GET TO ALICE BEFORE TODD.

benchmark.note: The template’s four buttons in order; the timer is an option.

decisions.title: Hide in corridor or fail to hide
decisions.context: Kara and Alice are in the corridor as Todd comes up the stairs.

options.label: HIDE IN CORRIDOR ✓
options.effect: Todd realizes Kara and Alice are gone.

options.label: FAIL TO HIDE ✗
options.effect: Todd takes Alice to her room: Get to Alice after Todd (TAKE GUN offered).

decisions.note: Partly a choice (stay in the corridor), partly a held input.

benchmark.note: Hiding carries a 10% risk (benchmark value, unsourced); staying fails to hide.

decisions.title: Lock door: grab lamp, talk to Alice, or open window
decisions.context: Todd pounds on the locked door: “ALICE! OPEN THIS FUCKIN’ DOOR!”

options.label: GRAB LAMP
options.effect: Todd breaks into bedroom.

options.label: TALK TO ALICE
options.effect: Todd breaks into bedroom.

options.label: OPEN WINDOW (way out seen in A New Home)
options.effect: GO OUT or SHUT WINDOW.

options.label: Do nothing
options.effect: Todd breaks into bedroom.

decisions.note: GRAB LAMP is on the chart and in the wiki, not in the template.

decisions.title: The window: GO OUT or SHUT WINDOW; JOIN ALICE or FACE TODD

options.label: GO OUT → JOIN ALICE
options.effect: Check: ESCAPE BY WINDOW ✓ → Run to the bus, or FAIL TO ESCAPE BY WINDOW ✗ → TODD BROKE KARA OUTSIDE (Experienced).

options.label: GO OUT → FACE TODD
options.effect: Defend Alice.

options.label: SHUT WINDOW
options.effect: Defend Alice (template).

decisions.note: On Casual a failed window escape leads to Defend Alice instead (wiki).

benchmark.note: Two template prompts; JOIN ALICE carries a 25% risk (benchmark value, unsourced); failure is a death (Experienced).

decisions.title: Todd breaks into the bedroom: REFUSE or ACCEPT
decisions.context: Todd: “The fuck are you doin’ here? Get outta my way!”

options.label: REFUSE
options.effect: “No. I won’t let you hurt her.” The fight.

options.label: ACCEPT
options.effect: Alice: “NO!” Kara changes her mind: “No.” The fight.

decisions.gate: After [ OUT OF TIME ], the lamp, talking to Alice or doing nothing.
decisions.note: The template places it under [ OUT OF TIME ]; the wiki lists the other triggers.

benchmark.note: Not offered after FACE TODD or SHUT WINDOW, which the template sends straight to the fight.

decisions.title: Get to Alice after Todd: threaten with gun, defend Alice, or too slow
decisions.context: Todd is beating Alice in her room: “I’m gonna give you a thrashin’ you won’t forget in a hurry.”

options.label: THREATEN WITH GUN (gun taken)
options.effect: Fight; Kara or Alice kills Todd.

options.label: DEFEND ALICE (unarmed)
options.effect: Fight; Stun Todd.

options.label: Take too much time → KARA IS TOO SLOW → TODD KILLS ALICE
options.effect: Ending (not required).

decisions.gate: After any shove, a failed hide, or SPEAK TO TODD.
decisions.note: Focus point GET TO ALICE AFTER TODD; the timeout is the template’s.

benchmark.note: Only the matching way in is offered (armed or not); staying out is the death.

decisions.title: Kara kills Todd or Alice kills Todd
decisions.context: Todd knocks the gun from Kara’s hand and beats her: “I own you! You do as I say!”

options.label: KARA KILLS TODD → KARA SHOT TODD
options.effect: Ending (cross-chapter): Todd dead, gun kept.

options.label: ALICE KILLS TODD → ALICE SHOT TODD
options.effect: Ending (cross-chapter): Todd dead, gun kept.

decisions.note: PowerPyx: pick the gun up again or not. Then OPEN FRONT DOOR → RUN TO THE BUS, unmissable.

benchmark.note: A choice with no risk, then a narrated event; todd false, gun true.

decisions.title: Defend Alice unarmed: Stun Todd
decisions.context: The unarmed fight in Alice’s room always ends with Kara pushing Todd down (PowerPyx).

options.label: STUN TODD → LEAVE THE ROOM
options.effect: Todd chases Kara.

decisions.gate: After DEFEND ALICE, REFUSE / ACCEPT, FACE TODD or SHUT WINDOW.
decisions.note: No death node in Alice’s room on the chart.

benchmark.note: A narrated event; sets ch07Fought (Todd hurt). The lone template RUN AWAY button is offered in K04l before the corridor and exit routes.

decisions.title: Todd chases Kara: front door, backyard, or caught
decisions.context: Todd: “You… You bitches! Come here... You ain’t goin’ nowhere! You’re mine!”

options.label: TRY FRONT DOOR
options.effect: Check: OPEN FRONT DOOR ✓ → the bus, or FAIL TO OPEN DOOR ✗ → Fight downstairs.

options.label: RUN TO BACKYARD
options.effect: Fight downstairs.

options.label: TODD CATCHES THEM → TODD BROKE KARA IN THE CORRIDOR
options.effect: Ending (not required; Experienced).

benchmark.note: The door carries a 25% risk (benchmark value, unsourced); sets ch07ToddChased.

decisions.title: Todd realizes Kara and Alice are gone: backyard or front door
decisions.context: Todd: “COME BACK HERE! You ain’t goin’ nowhere! You’re mine!”

options.label: RUN TO BACKYARD
options.effect: Fight downstairs.

options.label: TRY FRONT DOOR
options.effect: Check: OPEN FRONT DOOR ✓ → Run to the bus, or FAIL TO OPEN DOOR ✗ → Fight downstairs.

decisions.note: Hesitating leads to the fight too (wiki); not offered.

benchmark.note: The chart’s order; the door carries a 25% risk (benchmark value, unsourced).

decisions.title: Fight downstairs and escape via the yard
decisions.context: Todd catches Kara and Alice downstairs. Alice: “NO! Please stop! Stop! No, Dad! NO!”

options.label: ESCAPE FROM TODD ✓ → ESCAPE VIA YARD ✓
options.effect: Catch bus or miss bus.

options.label: TODD WINS FIGHT → TODD BROKE KARA DOWNSTAIRS
options.effect: Ending (not required; Experienced).

options.label: FAIL TO ESCAPE → TODD BROKE KARA OUTSIDE
options.effect: Ending (not required; Experienced).

decisions.gate: After RUN TO BACKYARD or FAIL TO OPEN DOOR, on either branch.
decisions.note: A Kara who hid gets a second chance to stun Todd downstairs; one who stunned him upstairs does not (wiki).

benchmark.note: Two single-action scenes with risks: the fight 20% (4% after hiding), the fence 10%; all benchmark values, unsourced.

decisions.title: Run to the bus: catch it or miss it
decisions.context: A bus pulls in across the street; Todd is coming after them.

options.label: CATCH BUS → KARA & ALICE EVADED TODD
options.effect: Ending (cross-chapter) when Kara never fought Todd: Todd alive.

options.label: CATCH BUS → KARA & ALICE FOUGHT THEIR WAY OUT
options.effect: Ending (cross-chapter) when she stunned or fought him: Todd alive, hurt.

options.label: MISS BUS → TODD BROKE KARA OUTSIDE
options.effect: Ending (not required; Experienced).

decisions.gate: After the window, the front door or the yard.
decisions.note: PowerPyx: “Miss Bus: don’t run towards the bus.”

benchmark.note: A choice with no risk; the ending depends on ch07Fought.
